hero.title: We are Passionate Sea People
hero.lede: You'll remember our crew longer than the boat.

intro:
We select our crew for two things.
1. How they handle a boat: safety first, a clean deck, everything in its place
2. and how they make people feel welcome on it.
We never hire one without the other.

They know this sea, they respect it, and they'll show you how to read it.
Below, each of them in their own words. Tell us who you'd like on board, and we'll do our best to match their schedule, though we can't always guarantee it.
gridTitle: Meet the people behind Eagle Ray Expeditions
